method: Compare raw six-axis float32 IMU key hashes in completed existing reception trace; count Sport packets whose key is absent from every received Low packet. Received counts equal rosbag topic counts.
conclusion: Recorded inputs omit encoder counterparts for 15.34% of Sport packets. Replay supplies IMU without foot observations for these interior packets. This establishes a recording limitation, not the exact live accepted sequence or proof that it caused all trajectory divergence.
pipeline: Raw Low is independently recorded by Python BEST_EFFORT subscription depth 200; live backend has a separate C++ Low subscriber. Same robot topics do not ensure equal subscriber histories.
